question: How do I enable Mermaid diagrams? Does this work with the v2.1.0 gem and what happens if the CDN fails?
expected: Development after v2.1.0 only; mermaid: true YAML boolean and fenced mermaid block; no extra plugin; CDN loads only enabled diagrams; source remains on failure.

result.answer:
To enable Mermaid diagrams, set `mermaid: true` as a YAML boolean in your page front matter or front matter defaults, then use a fenced `mermaid` code block.

```yaml
---
layout: default
mermaid: true
---
```

```mermaid
graph TD;
    A-->B;
```

Regarding your other questions:
* **Version support:** This feature is not included in the v2.1.0 gem or the pinned v2.1.0 remote theme; it is available in the development version after v2.1.0.
* **CDN failure:** If the jsDelivr CDN fails to load the Mermaid JavaScript library, the diagram code will remain visible in the visitor's page as plain text.

Sources: [Layouts - Mermaid diagrams](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts#mermaid-diagrams)
